# `kll_sketch_merge_bigint`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Merges two sketch buffers together into one.

**Applies to:** not available in Krishiv yet. Spark: 4.1 and later.

## Syntax

```text
kll_sketch_merge_bigint(left, right)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Not implemented yet |
| Group | `sketch_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 4.1.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 4.1 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- kll_sketch_merge_bigint, example 1
> SELECT LENGTH(kll_sketch_to_string_bigint(kll_sketch_merge_bigint(kll_sketch_agg_bigint(col), kll_sketch_agg_bigint(col)))) > 0 FROM VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4), (5) tab(col);
Error: KRISHIV_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 4.1.0.
